description: This file defines the HashedLinkService class, which manages hashed links including creation, validation, permission checks, and bulk operations within a feature related to hashed links in a system.

classes.name: HashedLinkService
classes.description: A service class for managing hashed links, including validation, creation, updating, deletion, and permission checks.

methods.name: normalizeLinkInput
methods.description: Normalizes link input to a consistent format, handling string or object input.

methods.name: handleMultiplePrivateLinks
methods.description: Handles bulk creation, update, and deletion of private links associated with an event type.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a hashed link without incrementing usage, throws error if invalid or expired.

methods.name: validateAndIncrementUsage
methods.description: Validates a link and increments usage count if applicable.

methods.name: findLinkWithDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific link.

methods.name: createLinkForEventType
methods.description: Creates a new link associated with a specific event type.

methods.name: updateLinkForEventType
methods.description: Updates an existing link for a specific event type.

methods.name: deleteLinkForEventType
methods.description: Deletes a link associated with a specific event type.

methods.name: listLinksByEventType
methods.description: Lists all links associated with a specific event type.

methods.name: checkUserPermissionForLink
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access a specific link based on event type ownership or team membership.
